synthetic_enrichment.summary: Database connection timeouts immediately following v2.4 service deployment under production traffic.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Spike in HTTP 504 Gateway Timeouts, API latency jumped from 45ms to 12,000ms, DB connection pool acquisition errors in application logs.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: HikariCP connection pool exhausted due to default maxPoolSize=10 remaining in application.yml instead of production config 50.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Updated database pool configuration in ConfigMap: maxPoolSize=50, connectionTimeout=30000ms. Performed rolling restart of deployment.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Enforce CI/CD linting rule to reject default dev connection pool sizes in staging and production manifests.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Sudden 401 Unauthorized storm across all mobile and web user sessions.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Global user logout event, 15,000 auth errors per minute, log message 'JWT signature verification failed: key expired'.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Public RS256 token-signing certificate reached midnight UTC expiration date; automated Cert-Manager renewal cron was failing due to IAM DNS permissions.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Manually rotated JWT signing keypair in HashiCorp Vault and bounced Auth Service pods to load the updated public JWKS keyset.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Configure PagerDuty alert for SSL/JWT certificate expiration at 30 days and 7 days thresholds.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Redis cache cluster memory saturation causing severe database read latency.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Redis memory usage hit 100%, evictions rate skyrocketed to 50k keys/sec, database read replica IOPS pegged at maximum capacity.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: A newly launched product recommendation widget was caching unbounded JSON payloads without TTL expiration policies.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Set volatile-lru eviction policy and attached 15-minute TTL to 'cart:recommendation:*' keys via hotfix patch.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Mandate default TTL middleware on all Redis cache write operations.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Kafka consumer group rebalance storm causing massive consumer lag.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Consumer lag exceeded 500,000 messages, frequent 'CommitFailedException' in worker logs, partitions continually reassigning.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: A heavy downstream warehouse sync step took 7 minutes, exceeding max.poll.interval.ms (set to 5 minutes), causing Kafka broker to mark consumer dead.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Increased max.poll.interval.ms from 300000ms to 900000ms and reduced max.poll.records from 500 to 100.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Decouple long-running synchronous external tasks from the main Kafka message consumption loop.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Kubernetes pods entering OOMKilled crash loop on node pool.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Multiple pod terminations with exit code 137 (OOMKilled), service availability dropping below 50%, 502 Bad Gateway responses.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: JVM max heap flag (-Xmx4g) exceeded the Kubernetes pod cgroup memory limit (container limit was set to 3.5GiB), triggering OS kernel kill.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Adjusted deployment memory request/limit to 6GiB and configured JVM flag to -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Standardize container sizing guidelines and eliminate hardcoded static -Xmx values in favor of dynamic MaxRAMPercentage.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Outbound order confirmation emails delayed by 45 minutes.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Outgoing queue backlog building up, SMTP connection timeouts, customer service tickets inquiring about missing order receipts.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Third-party SendGrid SMTP relay IP was rate-limited due to sudden marketing blast sending concurrent un-throttled newsletters.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Rerouted transactional receipt queue to secondary dedicated transactional IP pool and enabled leaky-bucket rate limiting.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Strictly segregate transactional emails and marketing broadcast traffic into separate independent mail relays.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: PostgreSQL database CPU pegged at 100% following database schema migration.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Invoice generation API timing out, database query queue length exceeding 200, sequential table scans detected on accounts table.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: A schema migration dropped a composite B-tree index on (account_id, billing_cycle), causing every invoice query to perform a full table scan on 40M rows.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Recreated index concurrently: 'CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_accounts_billing ON accounts(account_id, billing_cycle)'.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Mandate EXPLAIN ANALYZE checks in PR reviews for any migration script modifying database indexes.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Elasticsearch cluster state RED with multiple unassigned primary shards.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Product search returning HTTP 503, search indices failing read queries, Elasticsearch health status 'RED'.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Data node disk usage exceeded the 85% flood-stage disk watermark, triggering automatic index block on write and shard allocation freeze.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Purged 30-day-old log indices using ILM policy, freed 180GB disk space, and unblocked indices with index.blocks.read_only_allow_delete=false.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Configure auto-expansion for AWS EBS volumes when disk utilization reaches 75%.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Envoy proxy thread exhaustion causing cascading network connection resets across all external APIs.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Incoming TCP connections reset by peer, client errors '503 Service Unavailable: no healthy upstream', Envoy active connection count flatlined at maximum capacity.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: A single slow third-party geo-location service was holding upstream connections open for 60 seconds without a circuit breaker or route timeout.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Applied strict Envoy route timeout of 1500ms and enabled outlier detection with consecutive_5xx circuit breaker on geo-location cluster.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Default all external third-party HTTP routes to a maximum 2000ms timeout with automatic fallback responses.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Internal employee portal logins failing with timeout error.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Staff unable to access internal VPN and dashboard tools, LDAP query latency spikes exceeding 15,000ms.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: LDAP connection pool connection leak in Active Directory synchronization routine after an unhandled network socket exception.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Restarted LDAP bridge service to release orphaned TCP sockets and patched the socket close handler in a try-finally block.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Wrap all enterprise identity client connections in auto-closable connection managers.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Flink streaming job failing checkpointing and falling behind real-time transaction stream.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Transactions processed without real-time fraud scoring, RocksDB state backend checkpoint timeouts exceeding 10 minutes.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: AWS S3 storage throttled checkpoint write requests due to insufficient prefix partitioning on the state bucket.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Updated Flink checkpoint directory to use randomized hash prefixes in S3 URI to distribute request load across multiple AWS partition keys.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Include S3 key entropy design in all streaming storage architectures.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Docker image build steps failing across all engineering pull requests.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Jenkins/GitHub Actions runner errors 'No space left on device', build queue backed up with 120 pending pipelines.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Dangling Docker build layers and cache containers accumulated on runner ephemeral NVMe drives without automated garbage collection.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Executed 'docker system prune -af --volumes' across all runner nodes and deployed automated systemd timer for nightly image cleanup.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Install node-exporter disk alert on all self-hosted CI/CD runner pools.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Transactions failing with database deadlock errors during flash sale event.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: PostgreSQL errors 'deadlock detected: Process 14201 waits for ShareLock on transaction', payment processing failure rate 34%.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Two concurrent microservices were updating order status and account balance tables in reverse lock order (Service A: orders then accounts; Service B: accounts then orders).
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Hotfixed the balance reservation transaction sequence to acquire table locks in uniform sorted order across both microservices.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Establish uniform database resource locking order conventions in database engineering standards.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Intermittent DNS resolution failures for regional customer traffic.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Users in Asia-Pacific region encountering NXDOMAIN and DNS timeout errors, Cloudflare edge report showing 12% failed lookups.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Stale NS records on secondary DNS provider during multi-provider DNS migration; DNSSEC key tag mismatch prevented validation.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Updated DS records at domain registrar and synchronized DS digest keys across Route53 and Cloudflare DNS zones.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Add automated synthetic DNS check testing resolution across 10 global vantage points every 60 seconds.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Video processing jobs failing midway through MP4 generation.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Worker processes killed prematurely, job queue retrying indefinitely, FFmpeg exit code 1.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Ephemeral /tmp partition size was capped at 2GB in container spec, causing multi-gigabyte video transcoding buffers to fill disk space.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Mounted Kubernetes emptyDir volume backed by node storage onto /tmp with 20GiB capacity limit.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Ensure media processing services always mount dedicated scratch storage volumes.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: AWS ALB returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway to all incoming external traffic.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Sudden drop to 0 successful requests, ALB Target Group health checks failing simultaneously across all backend EC2 instances.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: A security group Terraform update inadvertently removed the inbound port 8080 rule allowing the ALB security group access to worker instances.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Reverted the Terraform security group commit and manually applied security group ingress rule allowing ALB CIDR on port 8080.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Introduce Terraform security group impact checks in CI pipelines to prevent accidental ingress rule deletion.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Prometheus metric scraper dropping scrapes and reporting high scrape duration.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Gaps in Grafana dashboards, Prometheus warning 'context deadline exceeded during scrape', CPU spike on metric scraper instances.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: A new debug metric was published with high-cardinality labels (including raw user_id and session_id), exploding Prometheus time-series count by 4,000,000.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Applied Prometheus metric relabeling config to drop 'user_id' and 'session_id' label dimensions at scrape time.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Enforce automated unit test checking that all Prometheus metric labels use low-cardinality enum values.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Twilio SMS delivery latency increased by 5 minutes for European phone numbers.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: User complaints regarding delayed two-factor authentication codes, Twilio status callback logs showing queued status.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Primary Twilio shortcode route experienced telecom operator degradation in Germany and France.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Toggled SMS provider fallback switch in config to route European numbers through MessageBird backup gateway.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Configure automated SMS provider failover based on P95 delivery latency exceeding 30 seconds.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Race condition causing double-credit on simultaneous top-up transactions.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Discrepancy in financial audit logs, multiple balance credit events recorded with identical timestamp within 5 milliseconds.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: Wallet service lacked optimistic locking or database row lock (SELECT FOR UPDATE) on the balance record during concurrent top-up requests.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Applied optimistic versioning column ('version') on wallet table and added idempotent Redis distributed lock around wallet credit mutation.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Mandate idempotent keys and optimistic concurrency control for all ledger-affecting APIs.

synthetic_enrichment.summary: Websocket gateway disconnecting 80,000 active client connections every 60 seconds.
synthetic_enrichment.symptoms: Reconnection storm hammering backend auth servers, client disconnect code 1006 (abnormal closure), client reconnect loop.
synthetic_enrichment.root_cause: AWS Network Load Balancer idle connection timeout was set to 60 seconds, while application websocket ping/pong heartbeat interval was configured to 90 seconds.
synthetic_enrichment.remediation: Reduced client websocket ping interval to 30 seconds and increased NLB client idle timeout to 350 seconds.
synthetic_enrichment.post_mortem: Synchronize all reverse proxy and load balancer idle timeouts with client heartbeat intervals in architectural runbooks.
